title: Agent Lifecycle Run Plan Issue Request
description: ALR-1102 Route 3 request (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:626-660): POST .../agent-lifecycle/run-plans. Issues a nonce-bound, content-free run plan against an already-minted AgentRevision (Route 1) and MeasurementContract (Route 2) -- this route never creates either. schema_version is a closed wire-version discriminator, not a product claim. The request carries no denominator, no completeness field, and no raw content: expected_count is computed exclusively from the already-accepted immutable contract membership by Backend, never supplied here. The optional experiment_run_ref is provenance only (never the lifecycle parent or identity) and is resolved same-scope by Backend; this is the only Part 1 writer of that field. `Idempotency-Key` (required, scoped to this route, same durable-replay mechanism as Routes 1-2) is a request HEADER, not a JSON body field, and is therefore out of this document's scope -- a missing/malformed header is `service_invalid` (corpus cases `run_plan_issue_missing_idempotency_key`, `idempotency_key_malformed_pattern_rejected`), decided at the route layer, not by a generic JSON Schema validator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:971). `StableOpaqueRef`/`TypedOpaqueRef` are common types (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:276-299) and live in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json (Terra review P2-2, 2026-08-10) -- this and the sibling agent_lifecycle_run_plan_issue_response_schema.json/agent_lifecycle_receipt_submit_*_schema.json files all $ref them cross-file rather than duplicating the shapes. Every top-level property below carries its own x-disclosure annotation at its own JSON Pointer per PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409's worked-table convention (use-site rules, not once at the shared type).

schema_version.description: Closed public wire-version discriminator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:272); never a product/version claim.

agent_revision_ref.description: Must already exist (minted by Route 1) and resolve in the authenticated tenant/project/owner scope; this route never creates a revision (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:639).

measurement_contract_ref.description: Must already exist (minted by Route 2) and resolve to one immutable Backend-held expected universe in the same scope (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:640).

experiment_run_ref.description: Optional provenance only, never the lifecycle parent or identity (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:641, :112). No version_id: StableOpaqueRef names a longitudinal Backend resource lifecycle does not mint or version.
